// The wipe list is built by spreading two other arrays, so its elements are not
// string literals. Unknowable statically → must be reported, not ignored.
process.env.NODE_ENV = 'local';

const { db } = require('../../src/utils/firebase');
const { clearCollection } = require('../helpers/firebase-emulator');

const CORE = ['users'];
const EXTRA = ['rooms'];
const ALL = [...CORE, ...EXTRA];

beforeEach(async () => {
  for (const c of ALL) await clearCollection(db, c);
});
